scope.mode: bounded local read-only source and accepted-receipt verification; only requested outputs written
scope.controller_locks: held by parent; not acquired, changed, or released

acceptance.note: 48,000 cached responses in acceptance is a separate study-wide count (32,000 training + 16,000 evaluation), not the per-head optimizer-update count.

rolling.startup: First 50 paid rows calibrate ranges before any updates. Empty replay buffer then processes all 400 rows, including the calibration prefix; no development tail override.
rolling.batch: At arrival t, min(t,50) replay entries plus the same current row again; consolidation batch size min(t,50)+1, maximum 51, at most 50 unique query IDs.
rolling.mask: Root-only clamps; every nonroot head is eligible on every arrival; persistent per-head Adam.

delivery.equation: U_delivery,head = 30,000 full-batch Adam updates on 400 paid rows; U_flat = 30,000 updates on one root-to-target head
delivery.warning: These counts do not match total compute: heads, batch sizes and supervision differ; rolling has 1.6 times as many optimizer steps per structured head, while delivery uses the full history at every update.

initialization.equation: seed(head n, r) = r + zero_based_index(order, n); seed(flat, r) = r + len(order)
initialization.interpretation: The same deterministic offset scheme is reused across all systems and histories, not an independent initialization draw per system. Within one input history at the same r, delivery/rolling/ablation structured heads start with identical parameter initialization. Across systems a repeated seed does not guarantee identical parameter tensors when parent dimensionality changes; normalizer buffers also vary. Flat is separately seeded and structurally different.
initialization.verification_limit: Source and accepted receipts verified; initial parameter tensors were not regenerated or compared.

archived_history.equation: N_paid = N_seed + N_observational_val + H_mechanisms * N_interventional_val_per_head + T * K + floor(T/R) * B_refresh = 3 + 500 + 5*500 + 200*4 + floor(200/5)*25 = 4,803
archived_history.visible_subtotal_correction: 500 + 200*4 + (200/5)*25 = 2,300 excludes both 3 seed rows and 2,500 interventional validation rows; including the stated 3 seeds gives 2,303. The missing large term is 5*500, not extra selected calls or duplicate training entries.
archived_history.selection_note: Selecting an already paid probe and duplicating it in consolidation cause no extra environment call. Query identities, not distinct action values, define paid rows.

graph.cost_branch: comm_cost is fit although it does not feed the target

eligibility.admitted_equation: 3 seed + 200 selected probes + 39*25 refresh rows = 1,178; final 25-row refresh occurs after last fit and is excluded from admitted union.
eligibility.mask: Exclude rows directly clamping a modeled mechanism from that mechanism; flat excludes any nonroot clamp. Interventional validation rows are paid and may enter later all-paid fits if eligible.

archived_history.attribution_initialization: Frozen Stage A adapter uses init + index(name in specifications(meta)); flat is index 0 and five structured heads have indices 1..5. This differs from prospective graph-order offsets. Reused across archived histories/row sets; not fresh random initialization per history.

failure_accounting.limit: 3,326 is arithmetic residual from the accepted aggregate receipt; individual discarded attempts were not re-audited here. Do not replace charged campaign total with 57,636 included rows.

physical.models: Two command inputs and one measured response (vis_3); one two-input neural head per arm, 4,417 parameters. No 25-head structured system in this physical task.
physical.initialization: manual_seed(0) is reset for every neural method in every condition; same starting parameter initialization, training-only output normalizers vary by condition.
physical.rolling_equation: U_roll,condition = 100*N_train,condition (77,200 to 81,500); last 50 training rows, persistent Adam, no separate 20-step fast phase.

preserved_original_pilot_failure.failure: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named experiments in thirty-node generator parity test
preserved_original_pilot_failure.cause: launcher did not place frozen project root on PYTHONPATH; local repository cwd had hidden the import dependency

failures_and_limits.brain_lookup: ACE 4803 lookup did not return within the bounded check; wait cell terminated. No archive result used; local original custody and source are the evidence.
not_claimed: No fresh optimizer instrumentation: update counts are supported by frozen loop source and accepted receipts.
No new checkpoint replay, model imports, response generation, refit, effect-size calculation, or significance calculation.
No claim that reused initialization seeds are independent random draws across systems.
No claim that 4,803 included rows exhaust charged campaign calls.

prospective_primary_fit_cpu_addendum_202.scope: Original prospective primary init0 arms only: 40 fits per family/arm = 20 systems x 2 histories; 6 groups and 240 fits total. Excludes init1/2 sensitivity, ablation, evaluation, and outer runtime setup/qualification stages. No new custody-wide verification.
prospective_primary_fit_cpu_addendum_202.method: Summarize receipt-level cpu_seconds (not sum of per-head timers); sum heads.*.parameters for model trainable parameter count. Standard-library reads/arithmetic only. Digests and acceptance identities are reused from the existing evidence, not reverified in this follow-up.

timing_definition.equation: C_fit = time.process_time() at fit-return accounting - cpu0 set after initial_models; group sum = sum(C_fit for 40 receipts); mean = sum/40; hours = sum/3600
timing_definition.excludes: Initial runtime imports, input validation, normalizer/model/optimizer initialization before cpu0; evaluation and outer runtime/qualification stages; later checkpoint serialization, process launch and scheduler wait.
timing_definition.includes: Training-loop tensor construction, optimizer work, in-fit helper/runtime calls and bookkeeping within the timer. It is process CPU, not optimizer-only time, elapsed wall time, or all-in study CPU.
timing_definition.units: process CPU seconds, plus summed process CPU hours; no GPU measurements

prospective_primary_fit_cpu_addendum_202.parameter_equation: P_head(d) = (64*d + 64) + (64*64 + 64) + (64 + 1) = 64*d + 4,289; P_structured = sum over all nonroot heads, including branches outside target ancestry. Normalization buffers and optimizer states are not trainable parameters.

parameter_summary.interpretation: Delivery and rolling structured counts agree; thirty-node total varies with graph parent counts, not history or optimizer budget. Counts summarize the 40 init0 fit receipts per structured arm.

current_observation_duplication.equation: B_t = min(t,50); consolidation entries = B_t + 1 = min(t,50)+1 for t=1,...,400
current_observation_duplication.conditions: Accepted prospective path: empty deque(maxlen=50), no online_tail override, append current row exactly once before calling original helper; no nonroot-clamped rows.

source_steps.operation: Append current entry, then call original archived update.
20 fast updates use X_t[-1:] (one current row); 100 consolidation updates use all eligible entries.

current_observation_duplication.clarification: The duplicate is in consolidation, not the fast singleton batch, and it does not create another optimizer update or paid response. Counts are of query identities; repeated action values can still have distinct query IDs. This exact formula is for prospective Stage B, not the separately implemented physical rolling comparator.

prospective_primary_fit_cpu_addendum_202.preservation: All original evidence JSON fields and the original Markdown prefix are preserved. No model execution, imports, checkpoints, new responses, tests, replays, commits or controller-lock operations.
